fieldValues.title: JSON Store
fieldValues.description: A single-file, self-contained JSON serialization of a complete SRS repository (`.srsj`), carrying identical semantic content to the filesystem repository layout defined by `ext:repository`. A conforming implementation must be able to convert between the two losslessly.
fieldValues.notes: Preferred over the filesystem layout when portability matters more than per-file inspection: emailing a repository, committing a snapshot as one artifact, or embedding a test fixture.
